hens_rule_text: up to 4 hens allowed on residential lots of at least 5,000 sq ft under the Urban Agriculture Ordinance; no roosters
permit_notes: No specific permit is needed if the lot-size and setback rules are followed, per news coverage of the ordinance.
setback_notes: Coops must be in the rear yard, at least 20 ft from neighboring homes and at least 5 ft from side or rear property lines.
coop_rules: Coop must be kept clean, dry and well ventilated; chickens and ducks must be confined when no one is present to respond to them.
zoning_notes: Rule comes from Stockton's Urban Agriculture Ordinance (city council approved it to allow chickens, ducks and bees on qualifying residential lots); minimum lot size of 5,000 sq ft applies.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.
